notes: Account background: legacy news publisher (print + digital). Large historical archive: articles, audio transcripts, investigative dossiers dating to 1990s.
Primary ask: replace brittle keyword search with RAG-backed semantic search + reranking to support journalist research, fact-checking, and legal discovery.
Data scale: estimate 30M raw documents, typical doc length 2k-10k tokens; planned chunking => ~200M chunks at 1k token windows with 200 token overlap (customer estimate).
Latency/cost targets: p50 target ~60ms, p95 <120ms, p99 <200ms for top-K retrieval + rerank within production query SLA. Cost per end-to-end query target < $0.03.
Retrieval architecture preference: hybrid candidate generation (BM25 + vector ANN) -> cross-encoder reranker (fine-tuned T5/monoBERT) -> passage consolidation + fusion.

Chunking debate notes: editorial wants sentence-boundary chunking to preserve narrative; eng wants fixed-token windows for predictable vector counts. Proposal: hybrid heuristics (headline/section-aware variable windows).

Reranker tuning: plan to ship 10k human labeled pairs (relevance grades) from newsroom; negative mining strategy: hard negatives from lexical baseline + in-batch negatives from embeddings. Evaluate with MRR, nDCG@10.

Indexing pipeline: bulk ingest via S3 -> dedupe by content hash -> language detection -> chunking -> embed -> push to vector index. Need throughput estimate: 200M embeddings in 3 weeks => ~1M embeddings/day sustained.

Storage + cost: customer's CFO flagged vector storage growth; exploring quantized embeddings (16-bit -> 8-bit) and cold tier for older archives. Also evaluating Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization profiles.
Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS, audit logs per-request, and EU data residency for a subset of archives. Legal: redact PII at ingest if flagged by NER.
Previous conversations: AE demo 2026-02-10 (showed hosted API proof-of-concept), security call 2026-02-22 with infosec (requested SOC2 artifact + encryption at rest details).
Quote from Head of Search: "We need recall without drowning editors in noise — reranker must give us salience and provenance."
Internal notes: SE to prototype hierarchical retrieval + small cross-encoder reranker on Redwood Dedicated GPUs. Expect 2-week spike for model fine-tuning and latency profiling.
Open asks: sample embeddings cost estimate for 200M vectors, benchmarking for p99 under 500 concurrent queries, and recommended chunk size for mixed long-form articles.
